limitations: Static archive/source inspection does not establish transitive dependency safety, platform support, behavior or no-JVM execution. Only sampled artifacts were downloaded and hash-verified; complete wheel filenames were inventoried from the index.
No candidate was installed, imported, executed or built; public package/source endpoints were read without personal credentials or Databricks workspace requests.
PyPI metadata and latest documentation can change; exact artifact/source hashes and inspection paths are retained. Pin and qualify actual runtime graphs in owning tasks before adoption.
